scope: Generate only the row-index-only FIT profile cache and its manifest after the manager's RAM preflight. This approval does not authorize CV fitting, score calculation, S1 gate execution, or full 3-fold execution.

review_findings.t5_leave_self_out_engine: Static review: local cell counts, global prior, smoothing, and coarse/global fallback remove the querying FIT vessel's own label.
review_findings.geometry_boundary: Train2026 and Test2025 stop-location geometry is used only for shared harbor aggregation. FIT own-mooring and active query profile scanners filter to fold0 FIT before row materialization. No labels, predictions, evaluation, or individual Test2025 output are projected.
review_findings.equivalence_limit: 3144 FIT vessels' log1p fishing-row counts are compared within 1e-6. Manifest explicitly records pointwise_mask_equivalence_verified=false; no pointwise mask comparison is claimed.
review_findings.temporary_data: The SQLite harbor distinct-key table is dropped and vacuumed on normal completion; the stage launcher removes its exact owned SQLite and sidecar paths after success, failure, deadline, or memory stop.
review_findings.input_integrity: The builder hashes all 12 source parquet inputs before use and rechecks them afterward; it also hashes and rechecks the baseline fold0 feature archive and validates feature_names[165].
